headline: Baku Race Day: Antonelli leads Mercedes front-row lockout for 51-lap street fight
whyCareReason: Kimi Antonelli starts from pole alongside George Russell as Mercedes locks out the front row in Baku. 51 laps through the castle chicane and 2.2km Caspian straight.
teaser: Saturday 26 September: 51-lap Azerbaijan Grand Prix at Baku City Circuit. Antonelli on pole, Russell P2, Leclerc P3, Norris P4. Lights out 15:00 local.
story:
Why this one matters: Saturday 26 September is race day at the 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix around the breathtaking Baku City Circuit.

Formula1.com and Sky Sports confirm that rookie sensation Kimi Antonelli seized pole position during Friday's qualifying with a scorching 1:40.445 lap, edging teammate George Russell by 0.082 seconds to secure an all-Mercedes front row. Charles Leclerc starts third for Ferrari with Lando Norris alongside on row two for McLaren.

With Baku's 51 laps notoriously unpredictable due to the 350 km/h slipstream along Neftchilar Avenue and the claustrophobic 7.6-meter Turn 8 pinch at the Old City castle, tire degradation and safety cars will dictate the outcome. Antonelli aims to extend his 81-point championship cushion, while Russell and Leclerc seek their own statement wins.
stakes: A Saturday race on a street circuit, with an 81-point lead that has not been tested in Azerbaijan.
rivalryAngle: Mercedes versus the rest, on a track that rewards the long straight and punishes the castle section.
